newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghans jailed for selling ice-cream to women.
newsitem.headline: Afghans jailed for selling ice-cream to women.

text.p: Islamic authorities in Afghanistan jailed two ice-cream vendors on Saturday for serving unveiled women, Kabul radio reported.

The Kabul vendors were sent to jail for two days because their customers had not kept themselves veiled head-to-toe, as required by the Islamic dress code which the Taleban movement has enforced since it captured the Afghan capital last September.
The Department for Promoting Virtue and Preventing Vice let the women off with a warning, said the radio broadcast heard in neighbouring Pakistan.
